enrichment.core_claim: Shared reports from nonspeaking autism, blindness, dark retreats, dreams, and psychedelics suggest the brain filters a broader field of consciousness via thalamic gating.
enrichment.ask_question: Which experiences from nonspeaking autistic people most shaped your neural transduction theory?
enrichment.challenge_question: Reduced gating could explain vivid experiences on a production view too; what prediction distinguishes filtering from producing?
